role: a bioacoustics researcher analysing field audio recordings
subject: a 10-second field audio recording (freefield1010 collection), sampled at 44.1 kHz, capturing an outdoor acoustic scene
property: whether any bird vocalisation is present in the clip (label hasbird: 1 = at least one bird audible, 0 = no bird), plus whatever ambient sound the recording contains
request: These are 2000 ten-second field recordings (freefield1010), each tagged hasbird = 0 or 1 for the presence of any bird call. Find a concrete, novel, testable question these audio recordings can answer, decide your own method, run real code, and produce a short publishable paper.

_demo.purpose: interface and perception smoke test; not the full paper evaluation
